source_text: Congregavit Iesus omnes tribus in Sichem — coram Deo. Narrat historia salutis ab Abraham usque ad terram datam.
pass_a_gloss: Gathered Jesus all tribes in Shechem — before God. He-narrates history of-salvation from Abraham as-far-as unto land given.
pass_b_english: [[Jesus gathers all tribes at Shechem before God >> Bible:Joshua 24:1]]. He recounts salvation history from Abraham to the given land.
